runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
The first search already answers this. OMB M-25-22 applies to contracts awarded under solicitations issued on or after 180 days after the memorandum's issuance.

This memorandum shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

So the answer is 180 days. The memorandum also does not cover AI acquired as a component of a National Security System (This memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.). The 180-day date is the applicability start; separate implementation deadlines, such as the 180-day deadline for full compliance in the consolidated table, appear in Appendix I of the same document.
